en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a dirt road and riders on donkeys or horses in the foreground. Trees line the road, and in the distance there are domed bathhouse-like buildings set against low hills or mountains. The printed caption in French at the bottom identifies the scene as the thermal baths of Bademli near Brousse. The design and typography are typical of early 20th‑century picture postcards.
